description:
[Wicked Memory] PERMANENTLY hard-delete a memory (right-to-be-forgotten). Default scope "chain" removes every version; "version" only this one. Only an audit row (no content) is kept.

Use when you must permanently erase a memory (right to be forgotten). Not for correcting it (use memory_update, which keeps history).

Behavior: DESTRUCTIVE and not reversible; confirm intent before calling.

memory_id.description: UUID of any version in the chain.

signature.description: Your wallet's signature over memory_prepare's message_to_sign.

name: memory_delete
